name: RG20269
tagline: Modern multi-functional warmth with a spacious culinary view
description: A sophisticated dual-compartment wood stove that redefines modern home heating. The Camiol RC1201A features a large firebox on the left and a dedicated oven on the right, both protected by expansive ceramic glass for an immersive view of the fire and your cooking. Designed with an integrated lower wood storage shelf and sleek vertical handles, this stove combines industrial durability with high-efficiency combustion for a centerpiece that is as practical as it is aesthetically striking.
features: Large integrated oven with built-in precision thermometer
Expansive ceramic glass windows for maximum flame visibility
Open lower wood storage compartment for convenience
